run_plot_metrics_cli: run the plot_metrics module with --file_path to generate training metric plots from a JSON file
create_plot_metric_epoch: create a plot comparing train and validation epoch metrics like loss or perplexity from JSON data
create_plot_metrics_by_step: create side-by-side plots of train and validation step metrics from JSON data
create_plot_single_metric_by_step: create a single line plot of a specific step-based metric from JSON data
refactor_plot_metrics_custom: refactor plot_metrics to support custom metric names beyond loss and perplexity
